items.title: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, in Abuja
items.summary: NPR, The Washington Post and France 24 report that Nigeria's health ministry confirmed an Ebola case in Abuja on 20 October, a woman who arrived from Uganda. She began showing symptoms on 7 October and was admitted to a private hospital on 11 October. Yahoo News and the WHO, as relayed there, say it is the Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or treatment, and that authorities are tracing 44 contacts. Contact counts may change, so treat them as provisional.
items.why: A spreading outbreak affects business travel, insurance and duty of care for employers, and is a live crisis-communication case for HR and brand teams.

items.title: A UN report says warming is set to exceed the 1.5C target
items.summary: UPI reports on a UN Environment Programme report published on 21 October saying global warming will exceed the Paris Agreement's 1.5 degrees Celsius target. The wire summary gives few details, so check the original report for figures.
items.why: Climate targets drive ESG reporting and employer branding, which many recruiters now raise in interviews.

items.title: Rubio presses for an early India-US trade deal after talks with Jaishankar
items.summary: Business Standard and ABC News (AP) report that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar in Mumbai and pushed for an early trade deal, saying the two sides are about as close as they can be without signing, with a small number of items left. AP-linked coverage also notes that Finance Minister Sitharaman had earlier said talks had plateaued, while Commerce Minister Goyal said the first tranche was in its final stages. Rubio also urged India to buy more fuel from the US and Venezuela. No signing date has been reported.
items.why: Tariff outcomes decide hiring in export-linked sectors such as textiles, auto parts and consumer goods that recruit MBAs.

items.title: Jio Platforms IPO subscribed about 2.5 times on day one
items.summary: Telangana Today reports that the Rs 30,213 crore Jio Platforms IPO was subscribed about 2.5 times by 3:15 pm on 21 October, with the institutional portion at 7.46 times and retail at about 60 per cent. Another report says the issue was fully subscribed within hours of opening. The final day-one number was not found, so treat figures as intraday. The issue closes on 23 October.
items.why: The scale of demand for India's biggest IPO shows investor appetite for consumer-tech brands and shapes how marketers value a brand story.

items.title: Sensex and Nifty fall for a second session on bank selling
items.summary: On 21 October the Nifty 50 fell 77.60 points to 22,811.35 and the Sensex lost 143.21 points to 73,709.69, the second straight loss, with banking and financial stocks, rising US bond yields and steady foreign investor selling weighing on markets. No RBI policy decision for October was found in the sources.
items.why: Weak banking and financial stocks hint at cautious hiring in the sectors that recruit the most MBAs.

items.title: Markets reopened on 21 October after the Dussehra holiday
items.summary: Earlier reports said exchanges were shut on 20 October and trading resumed on 21 October, when the Nifty ended at 22,811.35.
items.why: Holiday-shortened weeks affect when results and IPO subscriptions are reported.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, a proactive agent in research preview
items.summary: TechBuzz reports that Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a research preview of a proactive agent built on Claude Opus 5.5, gated behind a waitlist for US Pro and Max subscribers at existing usage limits, and aimed at professionals. Gizmodo notes it is not widely available yet. Details come from secondary outlets, so check Anthropic's announcement.
items.why: Proactive AI agents will change how marketers and HR teams hand off routine work, which is a common interview topic.

items.title: Nvidia unveils DSX POD and OpenShell at GTC Berlin
items.summary: Per a summary of Nvidia's GTC Berlin announcements, DSX POD is a modular data-centre reference design meant to cut AI-factory deployment from about six months to about 14 days. OpenShell is a reference architecture for running AI agents, with Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, Microsoft, Google Cloud and AWS named as working with it, according to Nvidia. The claims are company-reported.
items.why: Cheaper, faster AI infrastructure lowers the cost of the tools HR and marketing teams will buy.

items.title: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT ads to 26 more countries, 83 in total
items.summary: AI Weekly's roundup says OpenAI extended ads in ChatGPT to 26 new countries on 21 October, for a total of 83, still limited to the Free and Go tiers.
items.why: Ad formats inside AI assistants are a new channel marketers are being asked to plan for.
